title: Prior-Relief Reduction on Goodwill Credits
content:
**Clause.** A goodwill credit on a late fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is lowered by a prior-relief reduction, a flat dollar amount subtracted from the credit. It follows the goodwill reliefs on the contract dated fewer than 24 whole months before the request date, counting every waived late fee and every billing-correction principal credit on the contract as a goodwill relief: two or more take the two-relief goodwill reduction of 3.00; exactly one takes the one-relief goodwill reduction of 1.50; none takes no reduction.

| Goodwill reliefs in the 24-month window | Reduction |
|---|---|
| two or more | 3.00 |
| exactly one | 1.50 |
| none | none |

## Counting

- A waived late fee and a billing-correction principal credit each count as one relief.
- Hypothetical, request on 2026-10-12: a relief dated 2024-10-13 is 23 whole months back and counts; one dated 2024-10-12 is 24 whole months back and does not.
- Hypothetical: one waived late fee 20 whole months back and one billing-correction credit 5 whole months back make two reliefs, a reduction of 3.00.
